name: Heavy Weapon Launcher
asset_name: DATA RES Ability Bomber Missile Launcher
description: This upgrade unlocks the ability for a Bomber to mount one additional heavy weapons launcher.

name: EMP
description: This upgrade enables Rangers to fire an EMP attack (electromagnetic pulse) that temporarily disables enemy ships.

name: Field Repair
asset_name: DATA RES Ability Corvette Field Repair
description: Field Repairs allow for ships to fix their hull without docking to a station. Taking damage during repairs will halt them.

name: Speed Burst
asset_name: DATA RES Ability Striker Improved Engines
description: Allows strikers to temporarily increase their engine's power.

name: Wing Weapons
asset_name: DATA RES Ability Striker Weapons Wings
description: This upgrade unlocks the ability for a Striker to mount two additional wing-mounted weapons.

name: Laser-Guided Projectiles
asset_name: DATA RES Technology Weapon Anti Missile
description: This technology, based on hypervelocity projectiles and laser targeting, enables the creation of rapid-fire turrets capable of intercepting and downing enemy remote weapons, such as missiles and mines.

name: Enhanced Relay System
asset_name: DATA RES Technology Remote Energy Transfer System Advanced
description:
It enables more efficient power delivery to remote modules, allowing ships, whether constructed individually or from blueprints, to initialize faster and with greater precision, ensuring rapid deployment in critical situations.

Stats:
Deployer speed +50%
Deployer construction speed +50%
Deployer deploy speed +50%

name: Advanced Fighter
description: This research program unlocks the development of heavy fighter chassis, enabling the construction of versatile fighter-bombers.

name: Advanced Mechgun
description: This research program unlocks the development of heavy mechgun chassis, enabling the construction of versatile mechguns.

name: Advanced Structural Synergy
asset_name: DATA RES Technology Structural Sinergy Advanced
description:
This technology optimizes energy transfer through surface armor using advanced molecular and magnetic transmissions. The transferred energy is amplified, increasing the resistance of adjacent modules. Additionally, the range of energy transfer is extended. The system selectively distributes energy, focusing on modules under attack to ensure optimal defense during combat.

Stats:
Linked module health +40%
Cmd. Center health +40%

name: Advanced Warship
description: This research program unlocks the development of heavy warship chassis, enabling the construction of powerful warships.

name: Cloaking Field
description: This technology enables the generation of a localized spacetime distortion, causing radar signals to bend around the object, effectively masking its presence. This allows you to construct devices that hide your ships.

name: Concussion Missile
asset_name: DATA RES Technology Weapon Concussion Missile
description: The concussion missile is a long-range weapon known for its capability to inflict devastating damage on targets moving at a moderate speed and featuring medium to heavy armor.

name: Deflection Armors
description: Research advanced armors that utilize material deflection, based on titanium armor technology, to deflect incoming weapon attacks. These armors offer extended coverage and adapt to different surface shapes, enhancing your character's survivability in intense combat situations.

name: Defense Field
description: This technology harnesses magnetic energy to create a shield capable of repelling solid projectiles and energy-based weaponry. This allows you to construct shields to deflect incoming threats.

name: Drill Systems
description: Drill Systems enable close-range ramming and asteroid drilling; when activated, the high-speed drill pierces hulls and armor for heavy damage at sustained energy cost.

name: Remote Energy Transfer
asset_name: DATA RES Technology Remote Energy Transfer System
description: It allows the command center to transfer energy from the source to remote modules, enabling the construction of independent stations and warships. These ships/structures can be saved as blueprints and recalled in future games.

name: Volatile Combustion System
description: Unlocks advanced fuel mixtures and pressurized ignition systems designed for sustained flame projection. Enables deployment of short-range incendiary weapons ideal for crowd control and area denial.

name: Gatling Gun
asset_name: DATA RES Technology Weapon Gatling Gun
description: This heavy-duty Gatling Gun lays down a withering barrage of bullets, shredding through light/medium armored units. While its accuracy suffers at long range, its high rate make it perfect for taking down swarms of enemies.

name: Heavy Artillery Cannon
asset_name: DATA RES Technology Weapon Heavy Artillery
description: Heavy artillery technology delivers long-range, high-impact firepower through dense, large-caliber projectiles engineered for deep penetration. These weapons are built to breach fortified targets with decisive force.

name: Heavy Bomb Launcher
asset_name: DATA RES Technology Weapon Nuclear Bomb
description: Capable of launching high-impact micro nuke bombs, this weapon creates massive explosions that devastate enemy forces over a wide radius. It’s the perfect tool for clearing large groups of enemies or causing destruction in key locations.

name: Hypercell Storage
description: The Hypercell Storage system enables the accumulation of massive amounts of energy through advanced storage cells. It unlocks the Power Accumulators, allowing the fleet to store large quantities of energy and ensuring power availability even in the most resource-scarce situations.

name: Heavy Kinetic Cannon
asset_name: DATA RES Technology Weapon Heavy Kinetic
description: Heavy kinetic weapon technology represents an advanced category of armament systems characterized by their utilization of dense projectiles for maximum penetration. These weapons employ large-caliber rounds or ammunition to enhance armor-piercing capabilities.

name: Heavy Mine
description: Detonating on contact, heavy mines defend structures and warships against heavy enemy armor.

name: Kinetic Weapon
description: Kinetic weapon technology is a class of armament systems that rely on the principle of kinetic energy, harnessing the sheer force of fast-moving solid projectiles. These weapons propel dense projectiles at high velocities. Kinetic weapons are a versatile choice.

name: Laser Cannon
asset_name: DATA RES Technology Weapon Laser Cannon
description: The laser cannon represents the evolution in anti-light/medium armament technology. This weapon emits short but intense bursts of concentrated energy in the form of laser beams. Its main feature is the ability to inflict devastating damage at medium range on targets that aren't too fast.

name: Long-Range Missile
asset_name: DATA RES Technology Weapon Remote Missile
description: This long-range heavy missile is a weapon designed to target and destroy even the most heavily defended enemies. Once locked onto a target, the missile bypasses all shields and armor, delivering a fatal blow directly to the target and causing moderate area damage.

name: Long-Range Nuclear Bomb
asset_name: DATA RES Technology Weapon Remote Nuclear Bomb
description: This nuclear payload is a powerful, long-range weapon capable of targeting and annihilating enemy forces. Upon detonation, it releases a devastating shockwave, causing massive area-of-effect destruction.

name: Cluster Dispersion
description: This technology allows a missile container to travel toward the target and then split mid-air into multiple smaller missiles, each spreading out and dealing area damage on impact.

name: Nuclear Fusion Energy
description: This technology unlocks the ability to harness the energy produced by nuclear fusion, enabling the construction of the Nuclear Reactor and the generation of vast amounts of power to fuel the fleet.

name: Pulsar Cannon
asset_name: DATA RES Technology Weapon Pulsar Cannon
description: This innovative weapon harnesses the power of pulsating electromagnetic radiation, delivering concentrated energy bursts capable of penetrating shields and armor. Its characteristic is the ability to inflict damage on slow-moving, medium armored targets.

name: Quantum Core
description: This technology unlocks the construction of the Quantum Power Reactor, allowing the ship to harness the power of quantum fluctuations. It creates a highly efficient energy source, revolutionizing power generation.

name: Rotary Multi-Ion Acceleration
asset_name: DATA RES Technology Weapon Rotator Heavy Ion
description: This breakthrough refines the targeting and rotational control of heavy ion cannons, allowing for the development of a Rotator Heavy Ion Cannon. This advanced weapon delivers high-energy ion beams across multiple directions with precision, significantly improving its effectiveness against large-scale targets.

name: Rocket Missile
asset_name: DATA RES Technology Weapon Rocket Missile
description: Rocket missiles are the ultimate evolution of self-guided remote projectiles. They represent the finest in anti-medium armor systems. They perform at their best in long-range engagements, especially when the targets are light/medium armored with low/medium speed.

name: Radiant Shield
description:
This technology utilizes an advanced magnetic field to protect the ship from damage caused by radiation and high-energy particles. The Radiant Shield creates an invisible barrier that neutralizes the harmful effects of nebulas, ensuring safety during passage through highly radioactive regions.

Stats:
Radiation resistence +10%

name: Biomechanical Mining Swarms
description: Using biomechanical drones, the biominers, this technology allows for resource extraction from asteroids. The swarms return collected resources to the base for refining, maximizing efficiency.

name: Efficiency Field Generator
description: By enhancing energy flow, this technology creates a field that boosts the efficiency of resource collection and unloading operations. All nearby resource gathering and refining processes see a significant improvement.

name: RUs Fusion
description: This technology enables autonomous resource production by fusing available materials from storage. The unit has reduced storage capacity but can generate new resources without external input.

name: Asteroid Mining Docks
description: This advanced technology permits the construction of mining stations directly on asteroids, extracting raw materials straight from their surface for use in resource processing.

name: Heavy Ion Cannon
asset_name: DATA RES Technology Weapon Heavy Ion
description: This research advances the manipulation and acceleration of ionized particles, enabling the development of heavy ion cannons capable of delivering high-energy concentrated beams.

name: Structural Synergy
description:
This technology, harnessing molecular and magnetic transmission, allows surface armor to transfer energy to adjacent modules, significantly increasing their resistance to enemy attacks.

Stats:
Linked module health +30%
Cmd. Center health +30%

name: Spatial Sonar
description: Delve into the study of sound waves and their diverse characteristics. Develop advanced analysis techniques to identify and differentiate sound patterns emitted by different materials and objects. Allow construction of Space Sonars.

name: Titanium Armors
description: This technology enables the production of titanium armors that, despite their higher cost and construction time, offer top-tier protection. These armors superbly balance resistance to external threats and transmission of that resistance to adjacent modules.

name: Warp Disruption Field
description: This technology enables the generation of powerful disruption fields that can force enemy ships out of hyperspace. By interfering with warp drives, it prevents hostile fleets from retreating or launching surprise attacks, while causing damage to ships caught in the field.

name: Frontal Plasma Cannon
asset_name: DATA RES Technology Weapon Plasma Frontal
description: This research turns plasma weaponry into a fixed frontal cannon, trading turret flexibility for stronger containment and acceleration to deliver heavier, armor-piercing bolts.

name: Ion Cannon
description: This research unlocks the potential of harnessing charged particles for propulsion and weaponry. By manipulating ion beams, it enables the creation of high-energy weapons capable of piercing through heavy armor.

name: Plasma Cannon
description: This research unlocks the potential of magnetically confining super-heated plasma for both propulsion and weaponry. By stabilizing and accelerating dense plasma bolts, it enables the creation of high-energy weapons able to scorch through the heaviest armor.

name: Warp Drive Generator
description: This research allows for the construction warp modules. Enabling stations to warp your fleet across the map at the cost of resources and energy.

name: Extended Laser Guidance
asset_name: DATA RES Technology Extended Laser Guidance
description: Extends the effective range of laser-guided projectile systems, allowing rapid-fire anti-missile turrets to acquire and intercept enemy remote weapons from farther away.
